data.name: Gobinda
data.gender_notes: Gobinda is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gobinda is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'go-binda', which means 'to bind or tie to the Lord'. In Hindu mythology, Gobinda is often identified with Lord Krishna and is known as the god of fortune and pleasure. He is also considered a protector and a giver of boons. The name Gobinda carries the meaning “God of Fortune, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gobinda usually hope their child will grow to embody god of fortune, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gobinda total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
